units.source_text: 我拿着笔记本和盒饭站在他的身旁。

en.t: I stood beside him, holding my notebook and boxed lunch.

units.source_text: 我的影子笼罩着柏木的盒饭，他抬起头瞥了我一眼，

en.t: My shadow fell over Kashiwagi's boxed lunch, and he raised his head and glanced at me,

units.source_text: 旋即又把眼帘耷拉下来，继续他那单调的咀嚼，如同蚕儿嚼食桑叶一样。

en.t: then immediately lowered his eyelids again and went on with his monotonous chewing, like a silkworm eating mulberry leaves.
